title: WAF challenge responses are returned after the final retry
reasoning: browserFetch detects AWS WAF challenge/captcha responses, but the retry branch only runs while attempt < retries. On the last attempt, a response that is still a WAF challenge falls through to return response, so callers can receive challenge HTML/status as if it were the requested resource. Since WAF challenge responses can use successful HTTP status codes, downstream parsing or caching can treat an access failure as normal course data.
reproduction: Stub global fetch to always return a Response with header x-amzn-waf-action: challenge, then call browserFetch(url, { retries: 1 }). The helper resolves with the final challenge Response instead of rejecting after both attempts fail to bypass WAF.
recommendation: When isWafChallenge(response) is true, retry only if attempts remain; otherwise throw a specific error that includes the URL/attempt count. Consider cancelling the challenge response body before retrying.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for this feature, so there is no evidence that exhausted WAF retries are asserted as an error case.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Vitest test that stubs fetch to return x-amzn-waf-action: challenge for every attempt and asserts browserFetch rejects after retries + 1 calls rather than resolving with the final Response.
minimumFixScope: Update the WAF handling branch in apps/api/src/http/browser-fetch.ts and add a focused browserFetch unit test.
